description: This PHP file defines the class `UndeployedSubpanelImplementation`, which extends `AbstractMetaDataImplementation` and implements `MetaDataImplementationInterface`. It manages subpanel metadata for undeployed modules within SuiteCRM, specifically handling loading, saving, and version control of subpanel configurations, including history tracking. It contains constructor logic for initializing subpanel and module details, as well as methods for deploying (saving) subpanel definitions and retrieving language information.

classes.name: UndeployedSubpanelImplementation
classes.description: Manages the undeployed state of a subpanel in SuiteCRM, allowing loading, editing, and saving subpanel definitions with version control and history tracking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the subpanel implementation, loads module and layout configurations, and sets up language strings.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating default language usage.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Saves the provided layoutDefinitions as the new subpanel configuration and updates the history.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Placeholder method for retrieving the filename related to the subpanel; not yet implemented.
